Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 6, Verse 3

“For the sage who wishes to ascend to yoga, action is said to be the means. For one who has ascended to yoga, stillness is said to be the means.”

A genuinely useful distinction. The same practice is not right at every stage — work builds the climb, quiet consolidates the summit, and confusing the two wastes years.
